subject.title: Add Claws manifest schema and read-only plan CLI

question: Should OpenClaw accept this read-only Claws schema/CLI slice before the referenced Claws RFC is accepted, or should the implementation wait until the RFC contract is fixed and approved?
rationale: The PR introduces a new public manifest schema and root CLI surface whose shape will affect future ClawHub ingestion, install safety, and compatibility; static review cannot decide that product contract on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Fix contract fields and wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve or reject the RFC entry fields explicitly, add proof, and keep the PR paused until maintainers accept the RFC direction.

options.title: Sponsor an experimental read-only slice
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the risk of an early schema/CLI contract after the parser bug is fixed and the surface is documented as read-only.

options.title: Defer implementation to the RFC repo
options.body: Keep implementation PRs paused or closed until the RFC is accepted and the OpenClaw/ClawHub sequencing is settled.

recommendation.title: Fix contract fields and wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to preserve or reject the RFC entry fields explicitly, add proof, and keep the PR paused until maintainers accept the RFC direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available owner signal for CLI contract and ClawHub-adjacent install direction in the current repository history.
